note: The EVM mainnets Alchemy serves, mapped to chain IDs by hand from that page. Alchemy's table names chains but not their IDs, and the wallet keys everything on the ID, so the mapping is vendored here rather than re-derived by fuzzy name matching on every regeneration. Non-EVM chains Alchemy also serves (Solana, Bitcoin, Aptos, SUI, Starknet, Tron, the beacon endpoints) are deliberately absent: this wallet signs EVM transactions. Testnets are absent for the same reason they are absent from the shipped defaults — a wallet defaults to the chains value moves on. Three of Alchemy's EVM mainnets are absent: Mythos (24371) and Anime (69000) have no chainlist entry, so no endpoint could be found or probed for them; HyperEVM claims chain ID 999, which the ethereum-lists registry still assigns to Wanchain Testnet, and a registry that names the wrong chain for an ID is worse than no entry at all.
